lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into at least five distinct horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid rows to form a lattice-like grid pattern visible on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a high-intensity luminance peak on the upper edge and a low-intensity shadow immediately beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A localized cluster of high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's trailing edge and distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated white linear mark—potentially a healed laceration or parasitic trail—traverses diagonally across the dorsal-lateral region posterior to the gill slits.
